recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-12202 after accounting for the MedicationOrder-to-MedicationRequest evolution and later performer-to-dispenser rename; future changes should be handled by newer Pharmacy issues rather than reintroducing the old dispenseRequest.performer name.
issue_request: FHIR-12202 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request raised against DSTU2 MedicationOrder/MedicationPrescription asking to add an intended dispenser to MedicationOrder.dispenseRequest. The final resolution narrowed the requested reference to Organization after the reporter confirmed Practitioner was not a use case.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 3880b34a88fdb78ad02767cb665c33375ecbdc52 explicitly applied TR#12202 by adding MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.performer as a 0..1 Reference(Organization) with intended dispenser wording and an intendeddispenser search parameter in the historical spreadsheet source.
additional_context: MedicationOrder is now represented by MedicationRequest in current source, and source/fhir.ini records both that active resource and the legacy MedicationOrder mapping. Later Pharmacy work, especially FHIR-24701, renamed MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.performer to MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenser while keeping a compatibility alias from the old path. FHIR-12439 is related background for the separate top-level MedicationRequest.performer administration element, not a reversal of the dispense-request dispenser. FHIR-25743 later fixed an example that already used the current dispenser path. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-12202-specific or conflicting community decision; later implementer discussion uses MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenser for the intended dispense performer.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active MedicationRequest StructureDefinition already defines MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenser as 0..1 Reference(Organization) with intended dispense-performer wording, and the active search-parameter bundle exposes intended-dispenser over that path.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.performer to MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenser and is already audited on the combined branch.
Added the distinct top-level MedicationRequest.performer administration element and is already audited on the combined branch.
Fixed a MedicationRequest example reference that already used the current dispenseRequest.dispenser path.
